learned: 2026-10-05, by agent pass: a server-rendered SEO page listing every product under format headings (7G Jars 9, Flower/3.5G Mylars 7, Rosins 9, Donut Holes 9, Prerolls 9, Disposables 5), one emoji-prefixed line each. /products is a members-only points shop and /merch is apparel.
notes: The page is every market's (its footer lists delivery to Florida, Michigan, California, Pennsylvania); nothing on it is tagged by state. NY is restricted by format: the New York page (/new-york, a stocklist of about 30 NY dispensaries, updated 2026-06-02) says the brand came to New York with 'our flowers', and every NY listing of ours is a 7g jar or a 3.5g mylar. So the jar and mylar lines are kept and the rosins, donut holes, pre-rolls and disposables are skipped as other markets' products (the last three state no size either). Which strains each market gets is not on the site.

Lines read '🍒 Cherry Popperz 7G Jar' or '🔴 Mega Z: Red 3.5G Mylar' (some with no space after the emoji); the strain is the name between the emoji and the size. Stores write 'Flower Jar Cherry Popperz' and 'Mega Z Red', which match.
The page is hand-edited marketing copy, so expect drift; its non-product lines (website links, 'Shop now', delivery locations) are skipped.

skip.why: not a New York product: NY carries the flower (jars and mylars)
